title: Plasma panel suggestions for tablet mode
line: Panels have a new "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" visibility option: they hide in Tablet Mode and stay visible otherwise.
explanation: The reporter asked for tablet-friendly panel behaviour, most concretely being able to have the panel auto hide only in Tablet Mode. Panel visibility was a single mode applied all the time, so a tablet user had to choose between a panel that covers apps in Tablet Mode and one that also hides at the desk. The change adds an "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" visibility mode: the panel follows Tablet Mode through Kirigami's TabletModeWatcher and acts as Auto hide while it is on and as Always visible (reserving space) while it is off, switching live. visibilityMode stays the configured mode and a new read-only effectiveVisibilityMode gives the mode the panel currently acts as, used by the shell and Panel.qml.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: Add an Auto hide in Tablet Mode visibility mode

Panels could only auto hide all the time, so tablet users had to choose
between a panel in the way and one that also hides on the desktop. The
new mode auto hides in Tablet Mode and is always visible otherwise.

BUG: 517517

desktoppackage: Offer Auto hide in Tablet Mode for panels

The panel settings only listed visibility modes that apply all the time.
Add the Auto hide in Tablet Mode entry to the Visibility combobox, and
make the panel float and dodge following the mode it is acting as now.

BUG: 517517

media.caption: Panel Settings: Visibility only offers modes that apply all the time
Panel Settings: new "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" entry
Tablet Mode on: the bottom panel can't be set to hide only now, it stays
Tablet Mode on with the new mode: the panel hides and the desktop uses the freed space
Still in Tablet Mode: touching the bottom edge brings the panel back, as with Auto hide
